info.title: NYALES WEB-070 implemented agent delivery queue
info.description: Transport queue supports server-authored connection_probe only. This is not the planning job/graph/solver API from WEB-069. One pending probe per target agent, generation bound, 120-second lease, 3 attempts, 15-minute deadline; no road matrix or schedule publication.
